Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Single Server—Reserved capacity is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Single Server reserved capacity is now available to reserve compute power for your existing and future PostgreSQL servers. The new pricing option enables you to save up to 49 percent compared to the regular pay-as-you-go payment option for your PostgreSQL server vCores for a one-year period.
 
Read more about this announcement in our service documentation.
 
For more information, see the Azure Database for PostgreSQL pricing page.
